invalid_name: The name can be at most 40 characters, on one line
pending: Confirm this computer is yours in the app first, then rename it
not_running: Persona Link isn't running on this computer, so it can't ask the hub
passive: In passive mode the hub connects to this computer: rename it on the hub (admin page or app)
offline: Not connected to the hub right now. Try again once it's connected
unsupported: This hub can't rename computers yet. Update the hub, or rename it on the hub
timeout: The hub didn't answer in time. Try again
